title: NYC's "Click to Cancel" rule is now in effect
why_read: A regulatory/consumer-protection story with limited direct technical content, though relevant to engineers who build cancellation or subscription flows.
analysis: This covers a New York City consumer protection rule requiring businesses to make subscription cancellation as easy as signup, mirroring the FTC's federal rule. It's mostly a legal and business story rather than a technical one, though it has implications for engineers who implement billing and subscription cancellation flows. Worth a skim for product and backend engineers working on compliance but not deeply technical.
